thread:
zoe.marketing: Quick sync — battlecard refresh for the inference launch. Need a snappy 1-paragraph competitor-facing value prop, three short AE rebuttals (<=2 sentences each), and a single-line benchmark callout for the webinar slide. Can we do a rapid pass here?

drew.sales: Target buyer: infra/platform PMs and ML engs. They'll ask about operational lift and variability under burst.

emily.prod: Don't promise universal numbers. Use ranges and 'typical' language. Call out rollout tooling + model variants as a differentiator.

james.design: I'll mock a one-pager layout. Prefer a short hero sentence, 3 bullets (latency econ, predictable ops, rollout controls), then a footer with 'how we measured'. Keep visuals simple.

harper.data: Quick cohort insight: enterprise POC drop-off spikes when demo p95 > 400ms. So p95 matters for conversion.

bench-bot: internal-bench: public_endpoint p50=210ms p95=520ms; redwood_dedicated p50=88ms p95=240ms (kv-cache+quant); cost delta example: public ~ $0.028/1k, dedicated optimized ~ $0.011/1k. Flag: internal only.

drew.sales: Rebuttal frames draft: 1) "Cloud endpoints are convenient, but variability can break UX under bursty traffic." 2) "Self-hosting gives control but costs months of ops; our dedicated path reduces that tradeoff." 3) "Vendor SLAs without economic transparency leave teams guessing on unit costs."

emily.prod: Add a technical quick-arg for SREs: "Continuous batching + smart routing keeps tail latency bounded while lowering per-token cost."

zoe.marketing: Value prop paragraph draft: "Redwood makes inference operational: predictable latency, measurable unit economics, and rollout controls you can trust. We give teams the runtime and tooling to serve models at scale without trading away reliability or transparency."

james.design: Slide one-liner for benchmark: "Typical results: dedicated deployments cut median latency by ~2x and reduce per-token unit cost by up to half (workload-dependent). See methodology slide for details."

harper.data: Methodology blurb for slide: "Replayed 12k real requests across mixed sequence lengths, enabled KV cache and continuous batching, measured p50/p95 and normalized cost/1k tokens. Repro: `bench/repro/run.sh`"

drew.sales: AE opener (2 lines): "Hi — we help teams eliminate surprise inference costs and keep demo latency stable at scale. Can I send a short teardown of our benchmarks?"

zoe.marketing: Replace 'eliminate' with 'reduce' and add 'without long infra projects'. New: "Hi — we help teams reduce surprise inference costs and keep demo latency stable at scale without long infra projects. Can I send a short teardown of our benchmarks?"

bench-bot: compliance-note: avoid absolute claims like 'always' or 'guaranteed' in public materials. Use qualifiers.

emily.prod: Next steps: james to deliver one-pager mock + slide 1 by EOD, harper to provide final numbers and approved wording, drew to test AE rebuttals with two reps and report back, zoe to assemble battlecard and legal check.

drew.sales: I'll loop in @marta-legal for quick review once zoe posts the draft.

zoe.marketing: Thanks team. If anyone sees a must-remove phrase, flag now. Otherwise we'll lock and ship to field tomorrow morning. :sparkles:
